limitations.client_tools: kept and forwarded in official Messages; executed on the client. VM tools only with x-kin-workspace: vm
limitations.multi_turn_native: client-workspace keeps messages/tool_use/tool_result; vm-workspace still flattens
limitations.claude_session: sticky binds vm+account; Claude session is the client process
limitations.kernel: metadata-only; start/stop flip JSON flags, no KVM/QEMU
limitations.workspace: default client; opt-in vm via header x-kin-workspace: vm
limitations.forward: both modes: full VM-standard identity replace (creds+fingerprint+settings+session). transport differs via x-kin-forward: cli|relay
limitations.oauth: single writer persistOauthToVm (harvest from CLI or admin sessionKey import). never HTTP Claude with OAuth
